description: veil-api 0.10 from PyPI (Python bindings of the veil server; Linux wheels use the epoll readiness reactor). @app.get/@app.post handlers with path/query binding, dict responses serialized to JSON, async def handlers on veil's persistent asyncio event loop, @app.websocket for /ws, gRPC through the grpcio-generated servicer on veil.grpc.Server, /static/* through app.serve_dir, compression through [api] compression. One process with four listeners from the configuration file.
